title: Walk to Music Row: Nashville Home in Edgehill!
description:
Channel your inner music guru and discover what the fabulous Music City has to offer from this charming vacation rental, located in Nashville's Edgehill neighborhood! Sitting just a couple blocks from Music Row and a short Uber or leisurely walk to the heart of downtown, this location can't be beat. Have the time of your life bar hopping on Broadway, check out the city's countless music attractions, or catch a show at the Opry. During downtime, enjoy relaxing at the 3-bedroom, 2-bath home.

The space
Outdoor Entertainment Space | Pet Friendly | Walkable Location 

This sweet spot is a perfect home base for a family or friend group and their pup(s) - you'll love the large fenced yard and walkable proximity to Music Row's fantastic selection of bars, eateries, and live music joints! 

Bedroom 1: Queen Bed | Bedroom 2: Queen Bed | Bedroom 3: Full Bed | Living Room: Sleeper Sofa | Additional Sleeping: Pack 'n Play

KITCHEN: Fully equipped w/ cooking basics, 2-person breakfast bar, stainless steel appliances, refrigerator w/ icemaker, drip coffee maker, basic spices, blender, Crock-Pot
OUTDOOR LIVING: Private fenced-in yard w/ landscaping, pergola w/ bench, charcoal grill, 4-person patio table, fire pit 
INDOOR LIVING: 4 flat-screen TVs w/ cable, banquet-style dining table
GENERAL: Free WiFi, linens & towels, washer/dryer, heating & A/C, complimentary toiletries, ceiling fans, high chair
FAQ: ID required for check-in, pets fee (paid pre-trip)
PARKING: Driveway (2 vehicles), street parking
